measurement_semantics.bound_tag_peak: At each frozen pre-current-head sampling point, count (!Tagline.is_invalid_line() && payload.handle_live(tag_payload_handle)). measurement_semantics.physical_resident_peak: Payload slots with allocation_role RESIDENT at the frozen samplingpoint; not identical to boundTag count, and unifiedF may show1025 payloads while Tagbindings<=1024.
measurement_semantics.pending_landing_peak: RESIDENT-role occupied payloads in RESIDENT_FILL_PENDING or having pending_sector_mask. It excludes RO-role transactions and is not a total per-set RESERVEDTag highwater.
measurement_semantics.descriptor_peak: Cycle-sampled count of shared native+RO requester descriptors before currenthead admission; not unique pendingTag lines or per-set state.
measurement_semantics.peak_transactions: RO liveentry count sampled on every successful newtransactionadmit/merge; only admit can increase livecount, so it gives an event-tracked RO lifetime highwater. Includes attached/readywaiting/lowerpending states, not exactly RESERVEDTags.
measurement_semantics.peak_shared_descriptors_and_lines: Shared resources sampled by RO observe_peaks only on ROadmit/merge. Not complete native-only continuous highwater. Keep separate from cycle-sampled descriptor_peak.
measurement_semantics.peak_lower_transactions: RO entries with issued & ~ready, sampled on actual loweracceptance; fills/retire cannot increase it. Excludesnativeinflight/WB and doesnot give their setdistribution.
measurement_semantics.peak_independent_lower_lines: Unique canonical lines among RO issued-notreturned entries, same sourcehook; not same-set collisions.
measurement_semantics.wb_peak: Occupied WB-role slots in unifiedF. LegacyWBUF16 contributes16 to1168pool, but F ft_mode2 and wb_local_cap0 do not enforce WBrole<=16. DWT39/Vector36 are not quotafailures.
